text: Input is an array of users. Take users with active === true and a non-null, present email. Return an array of their emails converted to lowercase, sorted ascending by plain string comparison.
Compute the average of profile.age over users that have a numeric profile.age (skip users with missing profile, missing age, or null age). Return a number rounded to 1 decimal place.

Count users per country using profile.country, compared case-insensitively. Skip users whose country is missing or null. Return an object whose keys are the uppercase country codes and whose values are the counts.

Take issues with state "open" that have a label equal to "bug" (case-insensitive). Sort them by priority descending, ties by id ascending. Return an array of the ids of the first 2 issues in this order.
Count issues with state "open" per assignee. An issue whose assignee is null or missing is counted under the key "unassigned". Return an object mapping assignee to count.
Collect all labels from all issues (any state), lowercase them, remove duplicates, and return an array sorted ascending by plain string comparison.
Consider only "dependencies". Return an array of objects {"name","version"} where version is the version string with a single leading "^" or "~" removed (if present). Sort by name ascending.
Sum qty*price over all items of all orders whose status is "paid" or "shipped". Return the sum as a number rounded to 2 decimals.

For orders whose status is not "cancelled", compute each customer's total spend (sum of qty*price over items; orders with no items add 0). Return the top 2 customers as an array of objects {"customer","total"} sorted by total descending (ties by customer name ascending), with total rounded to 2 decimals.

Look at config.services (an object keyed by service name). Keep services where tls.enabled is exactly true (a missing tls or missing enabled counts as false). Return an array of "host:port" strings, in ascending order of service name; if port is missing use 80.

Each line is "<timestamp> <LEVEL> <service> <message...>" separated by single spaces. Count lines with level ERROR per service. Return an object mapping service to count, including only services with at least one ERROR.
Find lines with level WARN or ERROR whose message contains the word "timeout" (case-insensitive substring). Return the distinct service names of those lines as an array sorted ascending.

The file is CSV with a header row (name,dept,salary,start). Compute the average salary per dept, ignoring rows with an empty salary; omit departments with no salaries. Return an object mapping dept to the average rounded to the nearest integer (Math.round semantics).

Given this text: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." — split it into words (maximal runs of letters A-Z/a-z), lowercase them, and count occurrences. Return the top 3 words as an array of objects {"word","count"}, sorted by count descending, ties by word ascending.
